svg.aria-label: M(\omega,V) = \left(\omega_1\ \omega_2\ \cdots\ \omega_{n}\right) \left(\matrix{M^1{}_1 & M^1{}_2 & \cdots & M^1{}_n \cr M^2{}_1 & M^2{}_2 & \cdots & M^2{}_n \cr \cdot &\cdot & \cdots &\cdot \cr \cdot &\cdot & \cdots &\cdot \cr \cdot &\cdot & \cdots &\cdot \cr M^n{}_1 & M^n{}_2 & \cdots & M^n{}_n \cr}\right) \left(\matrix{V^1 \cr V^2 \cr \cdot\cr \cdot \cr \cdot\cr V^{n}\cr}\right) = \omega_i M^i{}_j V^j\ . \tag{1.54}
